title: Art Gallery
paragraphs: The newly refurbished art gallery displays original paintings by twenty-two member artists.
The “gallery down the alley” is located at 551 Main Street, Harwich Port 02646.

The Guild of Harwich Artists’ seasonal Art Gallery features 22 juried local artists using a variety of mediums. Our “gallery down the alley” is located at 551 Main Street, Harwich Port. Free parking is available across the street. The gallery is open seven days a week, 11am to 4pm, June through mid-October. We are also open weekends in the shoulder seasons: Mid-April through May and mid-October to mid-December. We invite you to stop by and engage with the rotating artists who staff the gallery.
